responsibility: Implements loop unswitching for invariant conditions in tree SSA loops. It detects loop-invariant branch conditions that are safe and profitable to move out of a loop, duplicates or versions the loop so each copy has a constant outcome for the selected condition, can hoist loop guards into preheaders, checks exit PHIs and value availability to preserve loop-closed SSA semantics, and rewrites the CFG so branch-dependent loop bodies become simpler and more optimizable.
